scene: The soda opens a shimmering back exit with three wild rides.
picture: Side view along a flat stone dock line. At far left stands a pedicab driver beside an empty bicycle rickshaw. You stand in the centre in your red poncho, wide straw hat, and back guitar, looking up at an open ferris gondola hanging up high. At far right sits an open brass book cart lift.
